summary: The legacy generic SPV record should resolve to the enduring CleanCapital Holdings LLC platform. Generate's 2017 role was a project-acquisition warehouse and sell-down structure rather than proven corporate equity, and Infranity's 2026 capital is debt. Manulife is the largest disclosed platform shareholder, but the model mixed self/project ownership into the parent cap table and exceeded the one-repair length contract, so application is blocked for manual normalization.
blockingQuestions: Normalize the parent-company owner array so CleanCapital is not represented as its own owner and project-level BlackRock/CarVal positions are not treated as parent equity.
Confirm whether Manulife alone is sufficient as the disclosed current sponsor representation or whether another current direct owner must be recorded.
Determine the safest historical disposition for Generate when the exact project-SPV sell-down dates and successor buyers are not publicly disclosed.
nonblockingDisclosureGaps: Exact legal names and complete asset schedule for the 2017 Generate warehouse SPVs are not publicly disclosed.
Exact Manulife stake and complete current shareholder percentages are not publicly disclosed.
